categories.main_business_segments: Suzhou Veichi Electric Co., Ltd. primarily operates in industrial automation, focusing on the research, development, production, and sales of industrial control products including variable frequency drives (VFDs), servo systems, and control systems such as PLCs and motion controllers. The company also extends into emerging sectors like robotics, new energy, medical devices, and digital energy solutions.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company has developed advanced core technologies including motor vector control, high-frequency injection control, motor parameter identification, PWM control, and servo control technologies. It employs matrix-style R&D organization integrating software, hardware, and structural design, with manufacturing processes covering PCBA production, sheet metal fabrication, assembly, software programming, and aging tests. It also utilizes digital and intelligent manufacturing methods, including automation and IoT integration.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Veichi serves a broad range of industries including heavy industry, light industry, high-end equipment manufacturing, new energy, robotics, medical, metallurgy, petrochemical, shipbuilding, port machinery, and smart energy management. Its customers include industrial automation equipment manufacturers, system integrators, and end-users in sectors such as steel, mining, petrochemical, logistics, textiles, and healthcare.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily in China with a strong domestic presence across 21 major cities supported by 314 distributors. It has expanded its international footprint with subsidiaries and warehouses in India, Hong Kong, and overseas markets, achieving significant overseas revenue growth, particularly in Southeast Asia and Europe.
categories.supply_chain_position: Veichi operates mainly in the midstream of the industrial automation supply chain, focusing on the design, manufacturing, and sales of core industrial control components and systems. It sources raw materials and components, performs in-house manufacturing of key parts, and supplies finished products to equipment manufacturers and system integrators downstream.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company prioritizes technological innovation with substantial R&D investment (13.25% of revenue in 2024), focusing on high-performance, high-reliability products and solutions in automation, robotics, new energy, and medical fields. It emphasizes digital transformation, intelligent manufacturing, and expanding its product portfolio to include AI-enabled robotics and smart energy management platforms. Veichi also pursues import substitution strategies and global market expansion.
categories.revenue_model: Veichi generates revenue primarily through product sales of industrial automation equipment including VFDs, servo systems, control systems, and digital energy products. It employs a mixed sales model combining direct sales to large industry clients and distributors for regional coverage. The company also offers customized system solutions and after-sales services.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: In the domestic low-voltage VFD market, Veichi ranks fourth among Chinese brands with a 2.49% market share, steadily closing the gap with international leaders like Siemens and ABB. In the servo systems market, it holds a 1.96% share with rapid growth. The company is recognized as a leading domestic industrial automation supplier with strong technological capabilities and increasing market penetration.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, Veichi reported revenue of approximately RMB 1.64 billion, a 25.7% increase year-over-year, and net profit attributable to shareholders of RMB 245 million, up 28.42%. The company has shown consistent growth in revenue, profit, and cash flow, supported by expanding product sales and overseas market development. Total assets reached RMB 3.07 billion, growing 20.82% from the prior year.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Veichi emphasizes high-quality, high-performance, and reliable industrial automation products with strong R&D-driven innovation. Its competitive advantages include comprehensive product lines covering control, drive, and execution layers, customized system solutions, and integration of AI and digital technologies. The company leverages local market responsiveness, cost advantages, and a robust service network to support manufacturing digitalization and green energy transitions.
